paite: Horeb tang a akiang ua thu akhun sim louh, TOUPA'N Moab gam a Israel suante kiang a Mosi thu akhunsak, athukhun thu hiaite ahi.
english: These are the words of the covenant which Yahweh commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

paite: Mosi in Israel mi tengteng asam a, akiang uah, Aigupta gam a Pharaoh, asikha tengteng leh agam tengteng tung a na mitmuh ngei ua TOUPA'N thil ahih tengteng na mu uhi.
heading: Moab Gam A Israel Toh Kal A Pathian
english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;

paite: Khemna thupi mahmahte, chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte na mit mahmah ua na muh uh.
english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N tuni tan in theisiam ding lungtang, mu thei ding mitte, za thei ding bilte ahon pe nai kei hi.
english: But Yahweh has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.

paite: Gamdai ah kum sawmli ka hon pi a; na puansilhte uh na silhtul kei ua, na khedapte uh leng na buntul kei lai uhi.
english: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown old on your feet.

paite: Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chih na theihna ding un tanghou na ne kei ua, uain hiam zu khauh hiam leng na dawn kei uhi.
english: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.

paite: Hiai mun na hong tun un Heshbon kumpipa Sihon leh Bashan kumpipa Og hon dou ding in ahong kuan ua, amau i na zou uh.
english: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.

paite: Agam uh i la ua, Reubente, Gadte, Manasseh nam kimkhatte luah ding in i pia uhi.
english: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.

paite: Na thilhih tengteng ua na lamzan zel theihna ding un hiai thukhun thute pom unla, zui un.
english: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.

paite: Tuni in na vek un, na nam lupente uh, na upate uh, na heutute uh leh Israel mi tengteng, TOUPA na Pathian ma ah na dingh ua;
english: All of you stand today in the presence of Yahweh your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,

paite: na taneute uh, na zite uh, na tenna ua gamdangmi na ompih uh, na singphukmi uh leh na tui tawi mite uh nangawn in;
english: your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh kichiamna leh athukhun tuni a nou toh abawl a na luttheihna ding un:
english: that you may enter into the covenant of Yahweh your God, and into his oath, which Yahweh your God makes with you today,

paite: Na pipute uh Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a ana kichiam bang leh na kiang ua ana gensa bang a amite hi ding a tuni a hon hihkip theihna ding leh na Pathian uh ahihtheihna ding in;
english: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

paite: hiai kichiamna leh thukhun na kiang kia ua khung ka hi kei;
english: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,

paite: tuni a TOUPA i Pathian uh ma a dinghte leh tua i kiang ua omloute kiang ah leng ahi.
english: but with those who stand here with us today before Yahweh our God, and also with those who are not here with us today

paite: Aigupta ota gam a i omdan, namdangte pal paisuak a i paidan bang uh na thei ua;
english: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed;

paite: alak ua athilkihhuaite uleh amilimte uh, sing leh suang, dangka chi leh dangka-eng leng na mu uh.
english: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);

paite: Huchi lou in zaw na lak ua pasal hiam, numei hiam, inkuan hiam, nam hiam, huai pathiante be ding in alungtang un tu in TOUPA i Pathian uh kiheisan in, na lak uah thil kha leh gamsai selkhiakna bulte na hong om kha ding uh.
english: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from Yahweh our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;

paite: Huchi ahihleh zaw, hiai hamsia thu samte azaktak in, amah kivualzawl tawm in, "Paupeng in pai teitei leng le ka bit na ding," chi in akingaihtuah kha ding.
english: and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart,” to destroy the moist with the dry.

paite: TOUPA'N angaidam het kei dia, TOUPA hehna leh amullitna in huai mi akhuh dia, hiai laibu a hamse tuang tengteng atung ah atung dia, TOUPA'N van nuai a pan amin athaimang zaw ding hi.
english: Yahweh will not pardon him, but then Yahweh’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and Yahweh will blot out his name from under the sky.

paite: Hiai Dan Bu a tuang hamsia thukhun tengteng bang in Israel nam tengteng lak a pan hihtuam in thil hoih lou lam ah TOUPA'N akhenkhe ding hi.
english: Yahweh will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this book of the law.

paite: Khangthak hong om ding, na nung ua na tate uh hong om ding leh gam gamlapi a pan a hong pai dingte'n, huai gam a hipi leh TOUPA'N natna aveisakte amu ding uhi.
english: The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses with which Yahweh has made it sick,

paite: Agam pumpi mei katsiat leh chi leh kat a dim, haichi lah kipawi lou, bangmah pou lou, sing leh lou bangmah om lou ahi ding. TOUPA heh leh thangpaihna Sodom leh Gomorrah, Admah leh Zeboim alumlet lai a siatna bangmah ahi ding.
english: that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which Yahweh overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath.

paite: "Nam teng in bangziak in ahia hiai gam hichi tel a TOUPA'N abawl? Hiai thangpaihna thupi bangchidan ahia?" achi ding uh.
english: Even all the nations will say, “Why has Yahweh done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”

paite: Mite'n, "Aigupta gam a pan apikhiak lai a TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian thukhun amau toh akhun amangngilh ziak un.
english: Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,

paite: pathian dangte, atheih ngei louh uh pathiante, ama'n asehsak louhte nna sem a, abiak ziak un.
english: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know and that he had not given to them.

paite: Hiai laibu a tuang hamsia tengteng tungsak ding in hiai gam tung ah TOUPA aheh hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.

paite: Thangpai, heh leh thangpai mahmah in agam ua kipan abotkhe vek a, gamdang ah asawnlut hi, tua a-omdan bang uh," achi ding uhi.
english: Yahweh rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”

paite: Thil kiselte TOUPA i Pathian a ahi, thil kiphoulakte bel hiai dan thu tengteng i zuihtheihna dia eite leh i suante a ahi gige ding ahi.
english: The secret things belong to Yahweh our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.
